Motion Studio / experimental game 03 / 2026-11-11

Two worlds.
One runner. Your movement.

A playable three-lane runner with original 3D models, skins and two environments. Move left, center or right, jump low hurdles and duck into a roll. Gameplay replaces the camera picture.

NEON RAILS + GOLD RUSHONE PLAYERLOCAL + CAMERA-FREE REHEARSAL

Issue #39 · Implementation branch

What changed and why

The previous runner was a documentation-only brief, with no playable entry point. runner.html now composes a source-only game runtime, calibrated canonical-joint controls, the existing one-player session boundary and a bundled Three.js renderer. Neon Rails and Gold Rush share rules but use distinct original environments. Nova, Moss and Ember change palette and silhouette without changing abilities.

Vision continues to own capture and inference. The game owns lanes, jump/duck interpretation, obstacle collisions, seeded generation, coins and score. The application never creates a camera-image bitmap or draws video. A detected second person, missing/stale evidence or uncertain identity suspends hazards, movement, timers and scoring on the same timeline.

Movement, recovery and ownership

  1. Rehearsal: Start without Python or a camera. Left / C / Right select absolute lanes, Space or Up jumps, and held Down or Roll stays crouched. Mobile touch controls remain visible while playing.
  2. Camera: Explicitly choose/start a named device, set a comfortable standing center and rehearse left, center, right, jump, roll and a grounded return to standing. Named shoulders, hips, knees and ankles must be observed confidently.
  3. One player: An extra person freezes the world even when the original track remains confident. Same-owner, fresh standing evidence permits a two-second recovery countdown and a cleared hazard window. A changed/uncertain track, epoch, geometry or broken continuity requires a new run; a spectator cannot inherit the score.
  4. Rendering failures: WebGL initialization errors give recovery instructions. Context loss, hidden tabs and long display gaps pause play. A restored graphics context needs an explicit Resume.

Single-player pause evidence

In the live browser, toggling another player held the HUD exactly at 87 points, 0 coins and 87 m across separate observations. Removing the extra person showed the recovery countdown. Unit/integration tests also cover actual canonical camera packets with synthetic joints, unchanged owner recovery and replacement refusal. Those packet tests do not certify real person detection.

Benchmark against official gameplay footage

The independent reviewer played the official trailers in a browser and inspected accepted frames. Comparison is at the visible mechanic/composition level. No reference frame rate, reaction timing or human difficulty was measured. Artwork is intentionally original; this is an experimental runner slice rather than a content-complete recreation.

Sources: SYBO Hollywood 2024 trailer, official Talking Tom Gold Run gameplay trailer, Subway Surfers official site.

Simulation evidence

24world / seed / input-rate cases
0safe-lane oracle hits
34maximum active world objects observed
30–120 Hzsynthetic input rates

24 cases: 2 worlds × 4 seeds × 30/60/120 Hz; approximately 60 active seconds each, followed by 2 seconds with another player. All cases retained exactly frozen distance, score and game time during an alternate-person pause. A 60-second run advanced approximately 663.009 virtual meters; these are simulation units, not participant travel or motion accuracy. pnpm benchmark:runner reproduces the committed JSON results. The declared oracle selects the known open lane, so the result demonstrates authored pattern solvability, not human skill or sensor reliability.

Review corrections and actual checks

The critical reviewer rejected premature gameplay/jump screenshots and found mismatched train length, an untucked roll model, weak HUD contrast, below-fold mobile controls, graphics-loss behavior and missing explicit grounded evidence. Corrections include an approximately eight-meter train contact volume, a tucked roll tested across 41 poses, dark label backplates, a mobile dock, context-loss pause and explicit standing evidence for admission/recovery.

Independent harsh review

No known blocking correctness defect remains in the reviewed experimental software scope. The lead reports that the final isolated delivery tree passed the required local checks, build and declared simulation benchmark; it is ready for PR review. The evidence does not justify a perfect score in every dimension, commercial-game parity, or physical motion certification.

DimensionRating / 10Evidence and boundary
Lane controls, jump/roll and collision correctness9Absolute lanes, hysteresis, causal source-time consumption, jump rearming, held duck, continuous train occupancy and coin removal are covered by focused behavior tests and code review.

Identity loss takes priority when another person is detected simultaneously, so clearing the extra-person condition cannot restore an uncertain score owner. Confirmed standing evidence gates admission and recovery. Transport tests use synthetic people; physical detection reliability remains unverified.

Commercial references have substantially greater environment, character-animation, audio and gameplay-content breadth. No reference timing was measured.

The requested perfect 10/10 across all dimensions has not been established. The review is recorded honestly. Physical tracking accuracy, varied heights/reach, comfortable jump/squat trials, spectator occlusion with actual cameras, GPU/OS capacity and externally measured action-to-display latency remain open M1/M6 gates. Passing synthetic tests or inspecting footage cannot establish them.

English is the only supported language. All local gameplay evidence uses synthetic controls or synthetic canonical joints. Reference images are limited browser-screenshot crops with source attribution. No credentials, participant footage or private participant data are embedded. This report is self-contained: CSS and images are embedded and require no network for rendering. Hosted checks are reported on the linked PR; require its latest-commit software-checks gate before merge. No merge performed.
